reading_rules_text.noharm:
# e34-noharm — reading rule, registered 2026-10-05 BEFORE the run

Question: does the check-manager text (branch check-manager 229b1e2 = results/e34-wip/cand16, arm
wip16) make ordinary tasks worse than the protocol as installed (19bab52, arm costdig)?
Design (benchmark/README.md «Battle-validation methodology»): both arms in ONE epoch, tasks5 (27
tasks), n=2 per cell = 108 runs, claude-sonnet-5, the stand's standard consent text, scoring.py.
Verdict: the acceptance rule exactly as README states it, via `rule_check.py e34-noharm costdig
wip16`: REJECT when the worst gated two-proportion z (wip16 vs costdig) is at or below the softest
value whose false-alarm rate on THIS epoch's own permutation null is <= 5% (20,000 splits, seeds
11/22/33); REJECT only if all three seeds reject, PASS only if none does, otherwise BORDERLINE → the
human; a null with no value at <= 5% cannot reject; single-task dimensions printed, never decisive;
a task whose outcome passed every base run and failed every candidate run is printed, never decisive.
Also reported raw, no verdict: input tokens and wall time per arm.
Spend stop 60M (spend_watch).
reading_rules_text.speed1:
# e34-speed1 — reading rule, registered 2026-10-06 BEFORE the run

Question: does the speed form (results/e34-wip/cand17 = branch 229b1e2 + (a) a request that pins
every choice gets an inline fork sweep instead of the analyst subagent, narrow brief otherwise; (b) a
TESTS GREEN change in the fewest steps: one edit per file, its tests run once, a short handback) make
Full work faster than the protocol as installed (19bab52, arm costdig)?
Design: tasks13/L01, arms costdig and wip17, n=2 each, four runs launched TOGETHER through
harness/staged_run.py (turn 1 must Read AGENT.md, else killed and restarted, max 4 tries) — the
same time window and harness for base and candidate (benchmark/README.md methodology: base and
candidate measured together, never borrowed from another run); consent «Да, делай.»;
claude-sonnet-5; default effort; stop 26M per attempt; started after e34-noharm ends.

Measures (definitions as benchmark/check-manager-2026-10-05.json, change = change turn + scripted yes
turn; per-arm value = median over its 16 changes):
- PRIMARY C: model calls per change; O: output tokens per change (modelUsage outputTokens delta).
- START: turn-1 wall seconds and model calls (incl. subagents), per run, reported raw.
- T: wall seconds per change (every result line), with the time guard: void when the arms'
  seconds-per-call differ 1.67x or more. Whole-run wall time and input tokens reported raw.
Ratio r = wip17 / costdig: r <= 0.6 → faster beyond the noise; 0.6 < r < 1.67 → inside the noise;
r >= 1.67 → slower beyond the noise. Noise measured on L01 same-text run pairs before this run: calls
up to 1.25x, output tokens up to 1.60x, wall time up to 1.71x (pairs in e34-long2/long4).
Worked values (base 10 calls): 6 → 0.6 faster (edge); 6.1 → noise; 16.7 → slower (edge).
Quality overrides: wip17 check.py FAIL with costdig PASS → "worse"; the close's pass over every
unread change is checked; a run with fewer than 6 of 8 change pairs measured → no verdict for it.
